name: RESOURCE-ATTRIBUTION / EQUAL-BUDGET TEST
purpose: Test whether observed A1 gains can be explained by resource/time allocation rather than by the cognitive scoring policy itself.
principle: Wall-clock time is not an intelligence metric. Use deterministic cognitive resource units instead.

resource_unit.definition: one candidate-model fit plus its validation scoring over a fixed validation subset

equal_budget_full.interpretation: Primary intelligence comparison at identical resources.

neutral_baseline.weights: verification only; all other orchestration weights zero

decision_rules.supports_not_resource_only: A1 MAE < A0 MAE at identical full budget and A1 beats A0 on at least 6 of 9 seeds; advantage must not require a larger resource unit count.
decision_rules.supports_resource_explanation: A1 advantage disappears or reverses when A0 and A1 receive identical deterministic resource budgets.
decision_rules.inconclusive: mixed seed results, material family regression, or advantage only at one budget level

claim_limit: A positive result only rejects a narrow resource-allocation-only explanation inside this synthetic benchmark. It does not demonstrate general intelligence, AGI, superintelligence, or autonomous self-improvement.
